articles.summary: Industrial tubing is often exposed to changing ambient temperatures, moisture, chemicals, physical wear, and other challenging operating conditions. Depending on the application, standard tubing may not provide enough protection to maintain reliable operation. Two commonly considered solutions are insulated tubing and heated tubing bundles.
